operations.rationale: The retrial at the Regional Court (proceeding_3) and the damages order (proceeding_damages_2) occurred on the same day (1998-05-27) as part of the same court session. The retrial node contains more comprehensive properties including participation and pre-trial detention.
The order regarding breaches of criminal procedure was issued by the Regional Court on 27 May 1998 as part of the same set of proceedings/session as the conviction (proceeding_3).
Both were interlocutory requests for the same court on the same day (1998-05-19). While distinct in request, they are usually treated as part of the same domestic procedural step before the court.
The Supreme Court decision of 10 August 1998 confirmed the overall judgment (including damages). They are the same decision.
The first trial judgment of 21 April 1997 included both the conviction and the damages order; these are not separate proceedings.
